sentences.text: The living room temperature dropped to 17.1 °C at 05:40, which is below 18.0 °C and the WHO recommends at least 18 °C indoors in cold seasons.
Later, between 05:40 and 06:00, the machines woke up and used 270 Wh, which was much higher than the expected 60 Wh.
Since the temperature was low and the energy usage was high, perhaps checking the heating might help keep things cozy.
